name: io.github.imokokok/oracle-insight
title: Oracle Insight
description: Pre-trade decision-input integrity for onchain AI agents: before a trade is signed, check whether the price it relies on is trustworthy. Returns an oracle-manipulation-aware verdict (PASS/WARN/BLOCK) from multi-provider oracle consensus, with verifiable EIP-712 attestations. Pay-per-call via x402 v2 in USDC.
